title: Extruded phrase swing-in with push
summary: A short bold phrase swings in letter by letter with a solid cobalt side extrusion, lands over a soft orange blob backdrop, then the camera pushes in to the end. Faux depth gives a 3D title without a 3D scene.
use_when: A 3 s title or slogan sting for a playful consumer brand
Opening card of a promo where one short phrase is the whole message
Silent social loop where type has to carry energy without UI
Bumper before or after a longer film

look.type_style: condensed heavy display sans, all caps, tight tracking, white face with a solid cobalt extrusion to the lower right, cap height ~12 % H, one line ~70 % W

structure.shot: empty warm orange backdrop with soft blurred darker blobs, then a 3-word slogan in extruded caps, centred, one line
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> 1.16 over 60 fr (f30-f90), accelerating (about 8 %/s then 14 %/s), easings.inQuad
structure.motion: backdrop blobs drift from f0; phrase appears ~f12 (±0.25 s); per letter swing from a ~10 deg tilted, rotated-in-depth pose to flat, left to right stagger (±0.25 s), extrusion swings with the face; lands ~8 % oversize at f23 and settles to 1.00 by f30 on springs.snappy (overshoot not measurable); then holds and pushes

params.brand: any brand.json: display font (condensed heavy works best), bg and accent for the backdrop blobs, fg for the face, a second colour for the extrusion
params.content.phrase: one slogan line, 2-4 words, all caps, fits ~70 % of the width
params.extrusion.depth: side depth in px at 1280 wide (reference ~10 px, lower right)
params.extrusion.color: extrusion side colour (reference: cobalt against warm orange)
params.timing.stagger: frames between letters (not measurable at 4 fps, start at 1)
params.push: [from, to] scale of the end push (default [1.0, 1.16])
params.aspect: 16:10 in the reference; any aspect, phrase capped at 70 % W

notes: Single shot, 3.00 s, no cuts. Entrance between 0.27 and 0.50 s; at 0.50 s left letters are near flat while the right ones are still tilted (stagger left to right). Phrase width 0.80 W at 0.77 s, 0.735 W at 1.00 s, 0.85 W at 2.77 s. motion.json: rotation 8.5 deg/s in second 0, zoom +8.3 %/s then +14.3 %/s. Extrusion is a solid cobalt side, no shading gradient, offset lower right; it reads as faux depth (stacked offset copies) and can be built in CSS/SVG without WebGL, though the vocabulary files extrude-type under 3d. Proposed term letter-swing-in (letters rotate in depth to flat with stagger) is not in the vocabulary. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent. Text face white and extrusion cobalt (about #FFFFFF / #2340B8 by eye) are not in palettegen output, which samples the dominant orange.
